# Contributing

Thanks for taking the time to contribute.

## Before you start

- Check open issues and pull requests to avoid duplicate work.
- For anything beyond a small fix, open an issue first to discuss the change.

## Making a change

1. Fork the repo and create a branch from `main`.
2. Make your change, with tests where applicable.
3. Keep commits focused; write clear, imperative commit messages (e.g. `fix: handle empty input`).
4. Open a pull request describing what changed and why.

## Pull requests

- Keep PRs small and scoped to one change.
- Link the related issue, if any.
- Be responsive to review feedback.

## Reporting bugs

Use the bug report issue template and include steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.

## Code of conduct

This project follows the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/dcondrey/.github/blob/main/.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
